name: echoes-off-world-field-guide
description: Echoes — Off-World Field Guide: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 backend and frontend integration foundation, plus Member 3 standalone deliverables.

scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@echoes/backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@echoes/frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@echoes/backend && npm run build --workspace=@echoes/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace=@echoes/backend && npm run test --workspace=@echoes/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@echoes/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=@echoes/frontend
